# Synthetic staffing fixture

**All files here are synthetic.** They are generated by
`scripts/make_staffing_fixture.py` from fixed constants and a seeded random
generator, shaped like the team's proposed PMIS-style schema. They contain no
observed operational data and must not be described as such.

| File | Grain | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `throughput.csv` | airport · checkpoint · modset · hour | Table 1 shape: one row per **active** modset-hour; `active_modsets` is the count of active modsets for that checkpoint-hour-screening_type |
| `wait_times.csv` | airport · checkpoint · screening_type · hour | Table 2 shape; flags are `p95_wait_minutes > 15` / `> 30` |
| `national_daily_baseline.csv` | national · day | Table 3 shape |
| `checkpoint_config.csv` | airport · checkpoint | staffing-owned: installed modsets, fixed posts, hours |
| `staffing_rules.csv` | machine_type · screening_type | staffing-owned: assumed capacity, staff per modset, relief factor |

Coverage: BWI, DCA, IAD; two checkpoints each; 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-11; hours
04–22. Regenerate with `uv run python scripts/make_staffing_fixture.py`. Replace
with the team seed when it lands; the tools read any directory set in
`STAFFING_DATA_DIR`.
